title: Alaska, California Guardsmen Conduct Rescue Operations in North Carolina
description: Alaska Air National Guard pararescuemen from the 176th Wing’s 212th Rescue Squadron replace pararescuemen and crew from the California Air National Guard’s 129th Rescue Wing to conduct site surveys for disaster relief centers and coordinate with local authorities to rescue isolated flood survivors from a CAANG HH-60 Pavehawk helicopter crewed by members of the AKANG’s 210th RSQ near Kinston, N.C., Sept. 16, 2018. Run Time: 01:22.
